items.headline: China lets provinces tap $82B in unspent bond quota to shore up growth
items.why: Targeted fiscal stimulus signals Beijing supporting growth/liquidity into year-end, relevant to China AI-capex and risk appetite.

items.headline: OpenAI ARR: Axios (9/29) reported ~$70B; Bloomberg/FT (10/8) say investors told ~$50B at Sept-end, $70B+ targeted by year-end
items.why: Gap between scoop and investor-told figure raises growth/accounting credibility questions ahead of heavy compute spend

items.headline: Fed minutes: Sept rate hike to 3.75-4.00% was unanimous but FOMC split on further 2026 hikes
items.why: Signals slower Fed tightening path into Oct 28 meeting; odds of another hike fell below 22%, risk-positive for AI-heavy equities

items.headline: DeepSeek nears $12B+ funding round with Tencent and CATL as top backers ahead of 2027 IPO
items.why: Cements DeepSeek as China's most capitalized AI lab, deepens Tencent's AI stake, sets up major 2027 China AI listing

items.headline: AI cloud/GPU neocloud Lambda raising up to $4B at $14.5B pre-money valuation ahead of planned 2027 IPO
items.why: Signals continued investor appetite for GPU-cloud neoclouds amid hyperscaler AI capex boom; adds to IPO pipeline

items.headline: Nvidia faces fresh scrutiny over network smuggling restricted AI chips into China via altered serial numbers
items.why: Raises enforcement risk for Nvidia's China AI-chip sales ahead of Nov 10 return of the US Affiliates export-control rule
